coverageNotes.2027: 2027 Chevrolet: 1 manufacturer-source-verified standard-equipment guide, 6 configurations. Missing technical specifications remain Unverified. Color references are not inventory claims.

vehicles.summary: Audited 2026 RAV4 Hybrid guide: six grades and nine FWD/AWD configurations. Brochure Standard/Available marks are preserved; published maximum torque and HEV-only applicability are clarified. Unresolved ratings and unexplained equipment blanks retain specific audit reasons.

sources.title: Toyota 2026 RAV4 brochure — supplied PDF, 30 pages; HEV grade/equipment tables pp. 17–25, package caveat p. 30
sources.scope: HEV tables only. Manufacturer link is the official model page, not a claim that this PDF was downloaded from that URL. Data-quality audit rechecked every previously Unverified HEV cell; maximum torque is quoted with unspecified basis. Plug-in-specific fields are classified not applicable to HEV, not inferred from blank matrix entries.

engine.value: Hybrid: 2.5L Dynamic Force four-cylinder with Toyota Hybrid System

torque.value: Brochure-listed maximum: 170 lb-ft (231 N·m); torque basis not specified
torque.conditions: Toyota brochure p. 25 marks this maximum S on all six HEV grades. It does not identify engine-only or combined-system torque. The release’s 163/172 lb-ft engine figures are not treated as equivalent metrics; do not sum motor and engine torque.

transmission.value: Electronically controlled continuously variable transmission (ECVT) with sequential shift mode

economy.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 6–7, 17–18, 25): The supplied brochure contains no configuration-specific fuel-economy ratings. The reviewed Toyota release has conflicting HEV estimates, and the EPA lookup is blocked by the proxy. Do not select a convenient number or label a manufacturer estimate EPA-certified.

towing.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 6, 26): Only the general up-to-3,500-lb headline appears in the brochure; the reviewed release does not establish this FWD configuration’s limit. A 900-lb example shown in footnote 12 is not a tow rating. The detailed Toyota specification PDF is blocked.

wheels.value: 17-inch dark gray metallic alloy wheels

appearance.value: Core design; color-keyed grille; low-profile roof rails; LED projector headlights

roof.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 20–21): This trim’s moonroof entries are blank in the HEV S/A matrix. The legend defines S and A but does not define blank as an explicit not-offered symbol. No negative availability claim is established by another reviewed source.

seating.value: 60/40 split reclining fold-flat rear seat; total seating capacity remains Unverified in the reviewed sources

heatedSeats.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 22): The LE seat row confirms fabric/manual seats, but neither that text nor the unexplained blank explicitly states front-seat heating is not offered. Do not infer absence from another trim’s heated-seat row.

ventilatedSeats.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 22): The trim’s seat row does not establish ventilation; the ventilation rows/marks apply to other named grades. No explicit negative availability statement was found for this configuration.

heatedWheel.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 21–22): LE has a standard urethane steering-wheel row, while the heated-wheel row is blank for LE. The brochure does not explicitly define that blank as not offered; another trim’s heated/leather wheel cannot establish LE availability.

instruments.value: 12.3-inch digital gauge cluster

audio.value: 6 speakers

phone.value: Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto

assistance.value: Backup camera with dynamic gridlines; Hill Start Assist; Trailer-Sway Control

safety.value: Toyota Safety Sense 4.0; eight airbags; Star Safety System; Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert and Safe Exit Alert; TPMS

electricRange.value: Not applicable — this is the conventional HEV, not a plug-in hybrid electric-range rating
electricRange.conditions: Classification-based not-applicable entry, not an inference from a blank equipment cell. HEV EV Mode still allows short, low-speed electric operation under limited conditions (footnote 61); no zero-mile range is invented.

wirelessCharging.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 23): LE/SE wired USB-C ports are documented, but their Qi charger entries are blank. Wired charging does not establish either presence or explicit exclusion of wireless charging.

headUpDisplay.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 18, 21): The brochure confirms the Limited HUD option but supplies no explicit availability/exclusion statement for this trim. No transfer of the Limited option is assumed.

cargoOutlet.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 23): Woodland’s 120V/1,500W outlet is explicit; this trim’s corresponding cell is blank. Standard 12V outlets do not establish the availability or exclusion of the different AC outlet.

advancedAssistance.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 24): The FCTA/LCA/TJA/Driver Monitor row has no S/A mark for LE/SE. Standard TSS 4.0 is separately verified and must not be confused with this additional group. No explicit not-offered definition applies to blank entries.

parkingAutomation.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 24): Advanced Park is explicitly A for XSE and S for Limited. Other grades are blank, without a defined negative symbol or an explicit exclusion. Parking Assist with Automatic Braking is a different feature and remains verified separately.

liftgate.conditions: Prior brochure audit (B1 pp. 20): LE’s power-liftgate entries are blank. The SE available and higher-grade standard entries do not verify LE availability or an explicit exclusion.

areaView.conditions: No independent surround-view availability or exclusion is established by the retained configuration-specific evidence. A standard rearview camera is not a surround-view camera.

adaptiveCruiseControl.value: Full-Speed Range Dynamic Radar Cruise Control (DRCC), part of Toyota Safety Sense 4.0

panoramicRoof.conditions: No configuration-specific panoramic-roof availability or explicit exclusion in retained evidence. Conventional moonroof availability does not establish a panoramic roof.

gains.text: Within HEV: gain 18-inch wheels, SofTex, an 8-way power driver seat, heated front seats and a power liftgate; add one wireless charger and front/rear Parking Assist with Automatic Braking.
FWD remains available. For AWD, listed towing capacity rises from 1,750 lb (LE) to 3,500 lb when properly equipped.
Limited is AWD-only. Gain a panoramic glass roof, hands-free liftgate, 12.9-inch screen and 9-speaker JBL audio.
Gain front-seat ventilation, heated rear outboard seats, power passenger seat, driver memory, heated steering wheel, two wireless chargers, 3D Panoramic View Monitor and Advanced Park.
XSE Hybrid is AWD-only. Gain 20-inch wheels, a moonroof, hands-free liftgate, Ultrasuede/SofTex and an 8-way power passenger seat with driver-seat memory.

XSE lists front-seat ventilation, a 12.9-inch screen, one wireless charger, 3D Panoramic View Monitor, Lane Change Assist and Front Cross-Traffic Alert as standard; unexplained SE table blanks do not prove those features are unavailable. Traffic Jam Assist requires active Drive Connect.

Choose a rugged HEV AWD alternative: all-terrain tires, raised rails/crossbars, 2-inch hitch with wiring, 8.5-inch ground clearance, LED fog lights, SofTex, heated steering wheel, all-weather mats and standard cargo AC outlet. This is a change of emphasis, not a claim that every SE feature carries over.

notes: The supplied Toyota 2026 RAV4 brochure verifies HEV equipment/optional marks and package names (pp. 17–25); the Toyota 2026 release verifies the HEV/PHEV configuration matrix and the explicitly named PHEV grade equipment. Verification is claim-specific, not a claim that every cell is known.

Brochure provenance: user supplied rav4_ebrochure.pdf (30 pages), SHA-256 b3bf909f6220343c8548ee9b004935317679a8c5e1444537083821e3896075a1. Its manufacturer link points to Toyota’s official model page; URL retrieval is not represented as a successful brochure download. The original PDF is retained with task attachments, not republished as website payload.

Data-quality audit: all 93 previously Unverified HEV equipment cells were individually checked. Nine torque cells now report the brochure’s explicit 170 lb-ft maximum with its unspecified basis. Twenty-seven plug-in-specific range/charging cells are classified Unavailable / not applicable to conventional HEV. Fifty-seven cells remain Unverified for the documented reasons in the audit; unexplained matrix blanks are not automatically negative availability claims.

Torque provenance: the brochure’s maximum is reported verbatim, not as a confirmed combined-system or engine-only figure. No engine/motor torque is added. Fuel economy and FWD towing still require accessible, configuration-specific official records; failed Toyota/EPA reads are not evidence that no published rating exists.

Fuel economy: the release conflicts internally. HEV FWD is described as up to 41, 43 and 44 combined mpg; XSE/Limited HEV are listed with 41 or 42 combined mpg and one inconsistent city/highway set. Woodland PHEV is given as 37 or 38 combined mpg; GR SPORT as 36 or 37. Unresolved MPG cells remain Unverified rather than selecting a convenient number. Woodland HEV and SE/XSE PHEV figures shown are manufacturer estimates, not verified EPA results.

The brochure names eight HEV package offerings and their grade eligibility, but does not itemize package contents. Package names are verified; contents, combinations and pricing remain Unverified. Its equipment tables mark S=Standard and A=Available; unexplained blank cells are treated as Unverified, not proof of Unavailable. PHEV packages are not verified by this HEV brochure.

The supplied brochure’s six-grade equipment tables cover HEV only; they do not verify PHEV/GR SPORT availability or packages. It does not resolve conflicting MPG in the release, provide a verified EPA fuel-economy table, clarify torque basis, or confirm total seating capacity, PHEV transmission type, or FWD/GR SPORT towing limits.

Confirm actual equipment and installed packages against the window sticker. Observe vehicle-specific towing/loading limits and charging requirements. Driver assistance is not autonomous driving; subscriptions, road and weather conditions apply.

2026-11-04 matching audit uses the retained brochure audit and cited equipment records; the original supplied PDF is not present in the current workspace and could not be downloaded (Toyota HTTP 403). Existing positive marks are preserved. Unexplained LE heating/roof blanks remain Unverified pending the original PDF or explicit manufacturer availability evidence. Plug-in-only fields are now classified Not Applicable.

gains.text: Gain 19-inch wheels, Leatherette & CloudTex, power driver seat, remote start, power liftgate and 10-color ambient lighting; panoramic sunroof becomes optional.
Gain 20-inch wheels, standard panoramic sunroof, black roof rails, illuminated door handles, stainless steel pedals, leather steering wheel and frameless auto-dimming mirror.

For 4MOTION: gain 268 hp / 258 lb-ft, Varenna leather, ventilated/massage front seats, rear outboard heating, 15-inch display, Harman Kardon audio, three-zone climate, Area View and Park Assist Plus; highway MPG changes from 30 to 29. Heated steering wheel has delayed availability. Silver roof rails replace black rails.

notes: VW-P: preliminary pricing/equipment, 3 pages; VW-T: final v2 technical specifications, 2 pages. Both downloaded and reviewed 2026-11-04. The pricing sheet has no printed publication/effective date; PDF metadata is not treated as an effective price date.
MSRP excludes $1,475 destination; each configuration shows base MSRP and the arithmetic total including destination. Pricing, equipment and specifications are subject to change.

Each equipment column was reviewed independently. S = standard, O = optional, dash = not offered in that equipment row; X identifies eligible option-package trims. Unexplained blanks are not treated as proof of absence. S has silver roof rails; SE R-Line Black has a frameless auto-dimming mirror, both positively marked in their own rows.

Fuel economy is quoted as Volkswagen-published consumption, not independently verified EPA records. FWD S: 26/34/29; other FWD: 25/32/28; non-Turbo 4MOTION: 22/30/25; Turbo 4MOTION: 22/29/25 MPG (city/highway/combined).
Cargo volumes are footnoted by Volkswagen as based on third-party testing. Headroom is retained both with and without sunroof; passenger volume is specified without sunroof only.

Earlier two-PDF review (before this order-guide import): Genuine gaps: SE R-Line Black curb weight is not specified (technical sheet lists S/SE only); head-up display and cargo AC outlet availability are not established; SEL 15-inch infotainment row does not itemize radio/Bluetooth/USB features bundled in the separate 12.9-inch row. No equipment carryover is assumed.

SEL R-Line Turbo is 4MOTION-only; no FWD record or invented price is created. Heated steering wheel/paddle shifters are listed standard with delayed availability. Confirm actual window sticker and production date.

Bulk order-guide import: 2025-10-09, reviewed 2026-11-04. Every equipment-table row is recorded separately by configuration. Factory packages, paint charges, market-delivery options and services retain distinct descriptions and restrictions. MSRP excludes destination. ID.4 prices marked TBA remain Unverified. Missing measurements require technical specifications. Original supplied PDF is not republished. Manufacturer source link is not a PDF download URL.

charging.conditions: Toyota estimates 10–80% in around 4 hours with Level 2 AC. All PHEVs include a dual-voltage 120V/240V cable.

dcCharging.value: Not offered: J1772; Level 1/2 AC charging only

liftgate.value: Power liftgate

adaptiveCruiseControl.value: Full-Speed Range Dynamic Radar Cruise Control (DRCC), part of Toyota Safety Sense 4.0
adaptiveCruiseControl.conditions: Adaptive cruise category; Toyota-specific system and operating limits retained. Driver supervision required. This is not Traffic Jam Assist or autonomous driving.

panoramicRoof.conditions: No configuration-specific panoramic-roof availability or explicit exclusion in retained evidence. Conventional moonroof availability does not establish a panoramic roof.

gains.text: Within PHEV AWD: gain an 11-kW AC charger, CCS1 port and DC fast charging instead of the SE’s 7-kW/J1772 AC-only arrangement.

Gain 20-inch wheels, moonroof, hands-free liftgate, Ultrasuede/SofTex with power front seats and driver memory, front-seat ventilation, 12.9-inch screen and 3D Panoramic View Monitor. Head-up display and cargo outlet are optional; packages unverified.

Choose a rugged PHEV AWD alternative with all-terrain tires, hitch/wiring, raised rails/crossbars, heated steering wheel and cargo AC outlet. Gain 11-kW/CCS1 DC charging; manufacturer-estimated EV range changes from 52 to 49 miles. Named packages and conflicting Woodland MPG remain unverified.
Choose the handling-focused PHEV AWD: GR-tuned suspension/steering, functional aero, 20-inch wheels, bolstered Brin Naub/SofTex sport seats, heated steering wheel and 12.9-inch screen.
GR SPORT retains 7-kW/J1772 AC-only charging; it does not gain XSE/Woodland DC charging. Manufacturer-estimated EV range is 48 miles. Do not treat GR SPORT as a universal equipment upgrade over XSE.

notes: Detailed PHEV specifications and package contents are awaiting separate documentation. The supplied 30-page RAV4 brochure equipment matrix covers six HEV grades, not these PHEV configurations. No HEV brochure equipment or packages have been copied here.
Only claims expressly supported by Toyota’s 2026 release are recorded. Missing fields remain Unverified; known release details do not make this a complete PHEV equipment guide.

The release conflicts on Woodland PHEV MPG (37 or 38 combined) and GR SPORT MPG (36 or 37 combined); those MPG cells remain Unverified. Displayed SE/XSE MPG and PHEV electric ranges are manufacturer estimates, not verified EPA ratings.

All four PHEVs are AWD with 324 net combined system hp. The 172 lb-ft figure is gasoline-engine-only. SE/GR SPORT use 7-kW/J1772 AC-only charging; XSE/Woodland use 11-kW/CCS1 with DC capability. Actual charging time and range vary.
Source-specific equipment and optional items are not a factory-package manifest. Confirm the actual vehicle window sticker and owner’s manual. Driver supervision and subscription conditions apply.

items.text: Volkswagen identifies the 2027 Atlas as ALL NEW. Output changes from 269 hp / 273 lb-ft to 282 hp / 258 lb-ft; the higher horsepower is accompanied by lower quoted torque.
The listed lineup is now SE, SE w/ Technology, SEL R-Line® and SEL Premium R-Line®. Atlas Peak Edition and the plain SEL name from 2026 are not listed in this edition.
The standard 12-inch center display is replaced by a 12.9-inch display on SE and a 15-inch display on SE w/ Technology and above. Dual front Qi chargers replace the single front charger.

SEL R-Line® and SEL Premium R-Line® add active ventilation for outboard second-row seats; 2026 documented rear heating without ventilation. New Varenna/Nappa upholstery choices, real wood décor and revised ambient lighting are detailed by trim.
Front/rear Park Distance Control and hands-free Easy Open/Easy Close are now standard even on SE; both were unavailable on 2026 SE.

Travel Assist adds assisted lane changing and Emergency Assist becomes Emergency Assist Plus. SEL Premium R-Line® adds Park Assist Plus with Memory Parking; the new seven-airbag protection system is documented across trims.
The SE w/ Technology Black Wheel Package changes from 20-inch 40T wheels to 54U wheels; the 2027 package carries limited availability ending CW02/27.

gaps: Volkswagen labels the model ALL NEW; the order guide does not establish new exterior/interior measurements or fuel economy. The p. 5 photo caption still mentions Atlas Peak Edition, although that trim is absent from the configuration and equipment tables. Confirm any later trim release separately.

caveats.text: Order guide 2026-09-28; pricing excludes destination; missing ratings/measurements and TBA prices remain Unverified. Full configuration-specific equipment, packages and source pages are in the online guide.

items.text: Volkswagen identifies the 2027 Atlas Cross Sport as ALL NEW. Output changes from 269 hp / 273 lb-ft to 282 hp / 258 lb-ft.
SE and SE w/ Technology retain FWD/AWD listings, followed by AWD SEL R-Line® and SEL Premium R-Line®. The 2026 plain SEL and SEL R-Line® Black names are no longer listed.
The 12-inch center display is replaced by 12.9 inches on SE and 15 inches on higher trims. Dual front Qi chargers replace the single front charger.

SEL R-Line® and SEL Premium R-Line® now document heated and actively ventilated outboard rear seats, plus Varenna/Nappa upholstery and revised interior lighting. The 2026 table documented rear heating without ventilation.

SE gains standard front/rear Park Distance Control and hands-free Easy Open/Easy Close, previously unavailable on SE. Assisted lane changing, Emergency Assist Plus and a seven-airbag system are documented; SEL Premium R-Line® adds Memory Parking.

items.text: SE R-Line® Black gains a standard heated steering wheel; the 2026 equipment matrix marked it not offered on that trim. The 2027 production credit 2PD can remove steering-wheel heating, so verify the actual window sticker.
The driver-assistance table now names Emergency Assist Plus instead of Emergency Assist.

gaps: The PJ2 wheel package still has conflicting wheel codes: U24 on p. 13 versus 48H on p. 16. Confirm the correct code with Volkswagen. Detailed 2027 fuel economy and measurements are not supplied; 2026 technical values have not been copied.

caveats.text: Order guide 2026-09-28; pricing excludes destination; missing ratings/measurements and TBA prices remain Unverified. Full configuration-specific equipment, packages and source pages are in the online guide.

items.text: A new Sport trim is listed in FWD and 4MOTION AWD, between S and SE. Its equipment includes GOAL-pattern cloth with yellow contrast stitching, black exterior accents and drivetrain-specific black wheels.
S gains standard MIB3 Composition Media and a six-speaker sound system. The 2026 S listing used Composition Color and did not offer the six-speaker system.

gaps: The SE FWD P35 wheel option from 2026 is not listed in the 2027 factory option table; absence from this non-exhaustive guide is not confirmation of discontinuation. Technical measurements, fuel economy and a tow rating require additional documentation.

caveats.text: Order guide 2026-09-28; pricing excludes destination; missing ratings/measurements and TBA prices remain Unverified. Full configuration-specific equipment, packages and source pages are in the online guide.

items.text: Golf R Black Edition is newly listed beside Golf R. Its documented standard distinctions include gloss-black 19-inch wheels, black badging/logos and black exhaust tips.

Akrapovič titanium exhaust is now a standalone factory option 0P8 for either trim. The 2026 guide bundled it in Euro Style Package POA. The POA roof/ventilation deletion package is not listed in this edition; do not label the retained standard roof and ventilated seats as newly added equipment.
Travel Assist adds assisted lane changing and the standard suite names Emergency Assist Plus instead of Emergency Assist.

gaps: The guide does not expressly confirm discontinuation of Euro Style Package POA; its absence is a listing change. Detailed 2027 fuel economy and technical measurements remain unresolved.

caveats.text: Order guide 2026-09-28; pricing excludes destination; missing ratings/measurements and TBA prices remain Unverified. Full configuration-specific equipment, packages and source pages are in the online guide.

items.text: The 2027 configuration table lists Autobahn with seven-speed DSG only; the 2026 table listed both six-speed manual and DSG. Do not carry the manual configuration into 2027 from the previous year.
The front/rear seatbelt reminder system is explicitly marked NEW and standard in the 2027 guide. No 2026 absence is inferred from its omission in that table.

gaps: The p. 38 illustration caption still says manual although the priced table lists only DSG. Manual availability requires Volkswagen clarification; the caption is not used to invent a configuration. The 2026 projector-headlamp description is absent from the 2027 table, so removal is not claimed. Fuel economy and technical measurements require the 2027 specifications.

caveats.text: Order guide 2026-09-28; pricing excludes destination; missing ratings/measurements and TBA prices remain Unverified. Full configuration-specific equipment, packages and source pages are in the online guide.
